claims: Independently ran the canonical signed-archive inspection from the clean frozen 31538ce source against attempt-2/WellSpent-0.2.0-9.xcarchive; it passed without modifying source, package or device state.

All four components have expected bundle identifiers and version 0.2.0 (9), phone arm64 and Watch arm64 plus arm64_32 architectures, valid strict signatures, authorized entitlements, embedded profiles and matching dSYM UUIDs/architectures.
The archive uses Apple Development signing; App Store distribution signing is independently verified in a separate export receipt.

The entire archive contains 56 regular files and no symlinks. Its relative file manifest SHA256 is 78e6f569821acecdeccac15a8a708afa2195869ec6845a28e382b95bfd8e76be; the canonical product manifest SHA256 is 136aaff8f7d120ecd5c9183ac7fe49275999d36119590b0cce95665f3c3980e5.

All four compiled privacy manifests exactly match their source property lists: tracking is false, tracking domains and collected-data types are empty, and required-reason API declarations are preserved. Canonical source/capability/dependency/Release-binary privacy and production-fixture isolation audits pass.

The compiled declarations and audited local-only design are consistent with the coordinator-observed App Store Data Not Collected answer; this receipt independently establishes package facts, not the external App Store observation.

The phone Assets.car contains distinct default and UIAppearanceDark AppIcon renditions, each opaque 1024 by 1024, 8-bit RGB in sRGB; the Watch contains its single default rendition. The archive and distribution-export rendition records and digests match.

All five corrected privacy, optional Watch notification, synchronized preference and phone-only erasure disclosure fragments are present in the production phone executable. The obsolete No data was sent anywhere claim is absent.

The exported native default PNG was decoded losslessly and visibly shows the approved abstract two-plane hourglass. Dark artwork was inspected in the exact frozen source; compiled dark and Watch presence is established by asset inventories and source provenance.
limitations: This passes only the signed-archive-inspection portion of ER-3. The canonical distribution-export gate initially failed because it assumes one phone icon rendition; its correction and independent rerun remain necessary.
The aggregate Xcode-generated privacy PDF has not been created because the Mac is locked. Manifest JSON inspection is not an Xcode privacy PDF.
Full CI, upload/processing, candidate screenshots, physical installation/upgrade/smoke, system appearance selection and App Review/public release remain separate evidence and authority boundaries.

No compiled dark or Watch pixels were extracted for independent visual comparison; their native rendition metadata and exact source provenance were inspected. The exported default PNG was visually inspected.
Historical superseded build 7, build 8 and initial build 9 artifacts remain separate and were not relabeled. This receipt binds only final attempt-2 source 31538ce.
